correctness.rationale: Let S=(2,2,2) smooth K3 in P5 containing a line E, H²=8,H.E=1,E²=-2, D=2H+E, C~mD smooth connected and disjoint E. Ambient S arithmetically Cohen–Macaulay gives H1(I_C(t))=H1(S,O((t-2m)H-mE)). For t<2m, Serre duality makes this h1(kH+mE), k=2m-t>0. Exact E-filtration with restriction O_E(k-2j), Kodaira vanishing of kH and h2=0, yields sum_{j=1}^m max(0,2j-k-1)=0 if t<=1, floor(t²/4) for 2<=t<=2m-1. At t=2m, mE rigid with h0=1,h2=0 and Riemann–Roch chi=2-m² gives h1=m²-1, not floor((2m)²/4). Adjunction and E|C trivial imply O_C(mH)^2=K_C; h0(C,mH)=4m²+2+floor(m²/4), odd exactly m=2 mod4. Reconstructed recurrence for m=1..20 and all t=-2..2m; checked sample m2/m3 and original verify_rao.py up to m64. These finite tests corroborate the unrestricted exact-sequence proof and not an independent geometric existence proof.
